prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity raster PNG concept screenshot, wide landscape 16:9, for an XFCE Linux desktop inside the Android app Termux Job's. The developer's existing application design is nearly black (#080e12), deep navy graphite panels (#111d25), restrained thin blue-gray borders (#263840), mint/teal accents (#83d7c5), white labels and muted gray secondary text. Rounded panels, practical software UI, polished but realistic XFCE, clear legible text. No physical phone mockup, no perspective, no marketing paragraphs, no artificial benchmark scores or fake real-time telemetry. This is a design preview only. Desktop icons must include exactly labelled shortcuts "GPU" and "GPU INFO", plus "Home" and "Downloads". A dark Thunar file manager window with a few folder icons may be visible. Brand text verbatim "Termux Job's". Other labels in English. Keep visual hierarchy calm and uncluttered. Do not draw Android navigation/IME keyboards. Variant 1, CLASSIC XFCE: thin full-width dark top panel with application menu at left and clock at right; mint active-workspace dot; subtly rounded dark file manager window centered-right with coherent toolbar and left sidebar, "Home", "Downloads", "Documents", "Projects". Desktop icons in a clean column at left. Small discreet centered bottom dock. Wallpaper is charcoal with very subtle mint contour curves at the far right, ample breathing room. Desktop feeling rather than mobile cards. Put small unobtrusive "CLASSIC" variant label beside the brand in top panel. Shapes mostly flat, crisp, no heavy bloom or glass.
